purpose: Pre-bump NixOS 25.11 evaluation baseline for phase 09 channel bump to nixos-26.05. Captured on the untouched tree before any file was edited.
make_check_status_caveat: This exit status was captured BEFORE Task 3 fixed the check target. The host-configuration loop in the pre-fix Makefile recipe ended in an echo, so a failing nix build inside the loop could not make the recipe exit non-zero. Treat make-check-2511.txt as the authority for the pre-bump state, not this number.

commands.make-check-2511.status: printf %s\\n $? > make-check-2511.status (exit status of the make check invocation above)
commands.capture-metadata.json: jq -n (this file; nixpkgs_rev_before read from nix flake metadata --json via .locks.nodes[.locks.nodes.root.inputs.nixpkgs].locked.rev)

notes: enabledServices.<host> is a JSON array produced by builtins.filter (flake.nix:391). The two services captures are sorted with jq -S sort so later diffs are order-insensitive. Do not write object-shaped assertions against them.
The root flake input named nixpkgs resolves to lock node nixpkgs_3, not the node literally named nixpkgs. Any assertion about the locked ref must dereference .locks.nodes.root.inputs.nixpkgs first.
